Weak-inversion NMOS pair (W=20 um, L=1 um, gm/Id about 20) gives gm of about 80 uS, so GBW is about 6 MHz. PMOS L=2 load (VA about 34 V) with NMOS L=1 gives gain about 45 dB. PARAMS = {
```python
    "Win":   (20.0, 8.0, 40.0),   # input pair W [um]
    "Lin":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),     # input pair L [um]
    "Wp":    (6.0, 3.0, 16.0),    # PMOS mirror load W [um]
    "Lp":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),     # PMOS mirror load L [um]
    "Wu":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),     # unit NMOS current-source finger W [um]
    "Lt":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),     # tail / reference L [um]
    "mt":    (4, 3, 4),           # tail fingers (ref diode has 5) -> Itail = mt/5 * 10uA
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl, iref = spec["cl"], spec["iref"]
    mref = 5
    mt = int(round(p["mt"]))
    itail = iref * mt / mref
    vdd = 1.8

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # reference diode sinks IREF
    n.M("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wu"], p["Lt"], m=mref)
    # tail source
    n.M("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wu"], p["Lt"], m=mt)
    # input pair: vinp drives the mirror-output side -> non-inverting
    n.M("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["Win"], p["Lin"])
    n.M("M2", "vout", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["Win"], p["Lin"])
    # PMOS mirror load (diode on x side)
    n.M("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wp"], p["Lp"])
    n.M("M4", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wp"], p["Lp"])

    # first-order predictions
    id1 = itail / 2
    gmid1 = 20.0                     # weak inversion at ~0.2 uA/um
    gm1 = gmid1 * id1
    VAn = 12.4 * p["Lin"]            # ~ (gm/gds / gm/Id) scaled with L
    VAp = 17.0 * p["Lp"]
    gds_out = id1 / VAn + id1 / VAp
    a0 = gm1 / gds_out
    cpar = 0.15e-12
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * (cl + cpar))
    gm3 = 10.0 * id1
    cmir = 2 * p["Wp"] * p["Lp"] * 6e-15 + 0.03e-12
    fp2 = gm3 / (2 * PI * cmir)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) * 0.5
    slew = itail / (cl + cpar)
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.3 / slew + 4.6 * tau
    power = vdd * (iref + itail)
    swing = (vdd - 0.15) - (0.9 - 0.5 + 0.1)
    return n, {
        "gain_db": 20 * math.log10(a0),
        "ugbw": ugbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "slew": slew,
        "settle": settle,
        "power": power,
        "swing": swing,
        "cmrr_db": 62.0,
        "psrr_db": 45.0,
        "noise_1k": 2.5e-7,
    }
```
